title: K01 Operator Control Contract
user_side_rule: The user controls intent, acceptance and promotion. The system controls coverage, traceability, coherence, freshness and bookkeeping.
session_start: Confirm the current Goal Lock shown by the system, or explicitly replace it.
Confirm the single ACTIVE engineering workpack, or explicitly park/replace it.
Review only typed blockers that affect the active workpack; do not manually audit all 17 domains.
If the system reports a CONTROL/CONFIGURATION/PROJECTION hold that does not block_active_workpack, continue engineering and park the control debt.
Before any mutation, confirm the action class: ENGINEERING_MUTATION / CONTROL_MUTATION / READ_ONLY / PROMOTION.
during_work: Do not open a second executable engineering workpack.
If new work appears, classify it WAITING_EXTERNAL / WAITING_DEPENDENCY / LATER / DEBT unless it replaces the active workpack by explicit decision.
Do not accept a PASS without scope (local/workpack/domain/product/release).
Do not promote generated reports to authority.
For a decision that uses a book/standard/manual, require source applicability and exact reference to be recorded.
close_workpack: Evidence exists and is bound to the exact input configuration.
Expected decision was reached or an explicit redesign/reopen trigger was created.
Affected downstream domains are refreshed or marked stale.
System recomputes the global project state and proposes the next executable workpack.
user_does_not_need_to_do: Manually inspect Git dirt unless the system reports a real configuration conflict
Manually track books/standards applicability outside the source registry
Treat every control-system defect as an engineering stop
